bank_plan.formula: (lesson_check_items + module_check_items) x 2 alternates + forms x form_length
bank_plan.eighty_twenty_note: 80% instruction / 20% assessment honoured at course level (I+A=T); bank serves lesson checks, module checks, 3 practice forms and a protected final.
bank_plan.size_band_note: Planning range per assessment standard (200-600 skills; 600-1500+ large certification). This is a planning guide, not proof of quality.

mcq_limitation_note: Official test assesses writing and speaking; MCQ/MR cannot assess productive skills. Mastemy teaches all four skills by video and model-answer analysis but scores only receptive and knowledge items.

items.stem: A GT Reading notice lists library opening hours but says nothing about holiday closures. A statement claims 'The library is closed on public holidays.' The answer is:

options.rationale: Correct: the notice is silent on holiday closures, so the claim is Not Given.
No holiday information is provided, so True is unsupported.
The text neither states nor contradicts the claim.
Only True, False or Not Given are valid answers.

items.explanation: Silence on a point means Not Given.

items.stem: In a matching-headings task, which basis should drive the choice of heading for a section?

options.text: The main idea of the whole section
options.rationale: Correct: headings summarise the section's central idea.
A keyword may appear in several sections and mislead.
The first sentence may not capture the whole section.
Length does not determine the main idea.

items.explanation: Match headings to the section's overall main idea, not isolated keywords.

items.stem: Which TWO strategies best suit the GT Reading paper, which gets harder from Section 1 to Section 3?

options.text: Working quickly through easier Section 1 to save time for Section 3
options.rationale: Correct: banking time early helps with the harder final section.

options.text: Transferring answers accurately within the 60 minutes
options.rationale: Correct: there is no extra transfer time, so accuracy in time matters.

options.text: Spending the same time on every section
options.rationale: Equal time ignores rising difficulty and wastes effort.

options.text: Skipping Section 1 to start with Section 3
options.rationale: Section 1 is quick, reliable marks; skipping it loses easy points.

options.text: Leaving items blank to avoid errors
options.rationale: No penalty for wrong answers means blanks waste marks.

items.explanation: Bank time on easier early sections and transfer accurately within the time limit.
